description: Source code for managing Trace2 environment settings in Git, including loading, retrieving, and releasing configuration values.

methods.name: tr2_sysenv_cb
methods.description: Callback function to process configuration key-value pairs and update environment settings.

methods.name: tr2_sysenv_load
methods.description: Loads Trace2 settings from system and global configuration files.

methods.name: tr2_sysenv_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified Trace2 environment variable, considering system, global, and environment sources.

methods.name: tr2_sysenv_display_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Trace2 environment variable.

methods.name: tr2_sysenv_release
methods.description: Frees allocated memory for all Trace2 environment setting values.
